query: INSERT INTO calendarobjects (principal, cal_id, id, uid, ics, first_occurence, last_occurence, etag, object_type) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, date(?), date(?), ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (principal, cal_id, id) DO UPDATE SET uid = excluded.uid, ics = excluded.ics, first_occurence = excluded.first_occurence, last_occurence = excluded.last_occurence, etag = excluded.etag, object_type = excluded.object_type, deleted_at = NULL
